text:
maya: Quick pulse — packed bringup numbers from yesterday + a simple unit-price scorecard. Need a short GTN recommendation (routing + fallback) by EOD. tl;dr below.

jordan: Awesome. drop the TL;DR pls.

maya: TL;DR: int8 looks like the production sweet spot for interactive GTN — ~40% cost savings vs fp16 with <0.5% quality hit on our core L2 signals. int4 saves more but shows spike in recall regressions on long prompts. Recommend primary=int8, fallback=fp16 for low-confidence/risky slices; consider int4 only for batch/rerank.

samir: numbers? can you paste the mini-table you ran?

maya: pasted below (small sample, 5k eval sessions, conversational latent-turn tasks):

```
Model            | config | p50 lat | p95 lat | cost / 1M toks | delta(core_score)
Packer-11B       | fp16   | 90ms    | 150ms   | $12.0          | baseline
Packer-11B       | int8   | 95ms    | 170ms   | $7.2           | -0.45%
Packer-11B       | int4   | 110ms   | 320ms   | $4.6           | -1.9% (long prompts)
Sparrow-7B       | int4   | 60ms    | 130ms   | $3.8           | -2.3% (low recall)

Notes: priming length + KV cache effects increase tokens/session by ~18% on our sample. int4 shows higher tail due to recompile/memory spill on >1024 seq.
```

olga: thanks. two quick clarifications: 1) what is core_score? 2) what's the cost calc (cloud vs dedicated)?

maya: core_score = weighted mix of exact-match + answer-safety + user-satisfaction proxy (composite normalized). Cost = effective infra + scheduler overhead normalized to 1M tokens; uses dedicated GPU price profile (our Dedicated pool).

dmitri: priming inflation matters — if tokens/session go +18%, the unit econ gap narrows. Quick calc: int8 -> ~40% cheaper than fp16 at current tokens, but with priming it's closer to 30%. Still often worth it for API.

jordan: Product ask — for GTN landing page we need a recommendation matrix: which model for interactive, long-form, and rerank. My take: interactive=packer-11b-int8, long-form=fp16, rerank=sparrow-7b-int4. Thoughts?

samir: agree mostly. but long-form could use int8 with longer KV cache tuned, if we can accept slight quality hit. fp16 is safer for HQ customers.

olga: gating rule idea: route by quality-confidence score (model-internal token-level entropy proxy). If confidence < threshold T1 -> route to fp16. If >= T1 and latency SLA required -> int8. For non-critical bulk rerank -> int4. We should instrument false-negative/positive rates for the confidence proxy before auto-routing.

maya: proposed thresholds (start conservative):
- T1 (high risk) = model_confidence <= 0.78 -> fallback to fp16
- T2 (low sensitivity) = model_confidence >= 0.92 -> allow int4 for rerank/batch
- otherwise -> int8 primary

samir: how to evaluate T1/T2? we can run a 7-day shadow test with split 5% traffic using dual scoring: primary=int8 + shadow=fp16, collect delta@top1 and user-signal proxy. monitor p95 latency and cost.

dmitri: add the priming-adjusted econ: run the same shadow accounting for +18% token delta. If int8 still saves >20% net and quality delta < 0.6% -> thumbs up for rollout.

jordan: what about canary size / KPIs for GTN? product wants concrete stop criteria.

maya: suggested canary: 5% traffic, 72h minimum. KPIs/stop criteria:
- delta_core_score <= 0.6% (on net sample)
- p95 latency increase <= 15% absolute (or keep below SLA 350ms)
- user-reported failure rate increase <= 0.05% (support tickets)
- cost savings >= 18% after priming adjustment
If any fail -> rollback and triage.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary job started for packer-11b-int8 shadow vs fp16 on 5% traffic. job id: cb-2026-84.

olga: small ops note — int4 nodes need different memory config. if we enable int4 for rerank, add a staggered rollout to avoid GC/memory thrash.

samir: product/gtm guidance for docs: say "Primary: int8 for interactive (recommended), Fallback: fp16 for high-risk inputs, Batch/Rerank: int4 where acceptable". Include quantified caveats (expected quality delta numbers and token inflation).

jordan: I'll draft the short paragraph for GTN with the matrix and send to marketing.

maya: Action items:
- jordan: draft GTN copy + matrix (today)
- samir: set up 7-day shadow with priming adjustment, collect delta metrics (start tomorrow)
- olga: prepare routing prototype (confidence proxy + gating) and run local sim
- dmitri: run priming-econ calc and post updated numbers to the thread

maya: thanks all :) :rocket:
